hyp.code_patch:
import numpy as np
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    t = df[train.TIME].to_numpy() if train.TIME in df.columns else np.arange(len(df))
    order = np.argsort(t, kind='stable')
    n = len(df)
    cut = int(n * 0.75)
    tr = order[:cut]
    te = order[cut:]
    f = train.feats(df)
    X = df[f].to_numpy()
    y = df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(X[tr], y[tr], X[te], seed)
    return (y[te], y_pred)
